mapper.select: select `id`,`user_id`,`name`,`asset_type`,`target`,`port`,`ssh_user`,`enabled`, `last_status`,`last_detail`,date_format(`last_check_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as `last_check_time`, date_format(`create_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as `create_time` from `patrol_asset` where `user_id`=#{userId} order by `id` desc
mapper.insert: insert into `patrol_setting` (`user_id`,`push_hour`,`channel`,`robot_id`,`email`,`enabled`) values (#{userId},#{pushHour},#{channel},#{robotId},#{email},#{enabled}) on duplicate key update `push_hour`=values(`push_hour`), `channel`=values(`channel`), `robot_id`=values(`robot_id`), `email`=values(`email`), `enabled`=values(`enabled`)
mapper.select: select `user_id`,`push_hour`,`channel`,`robot_id`,`email` from `patrol_setting` where `enabled`=1 and `push_hour`=#{hour} and ((`channel`='dingtalk' and `robot_id` is not null) or (`channel`='email' and `email` is not null and `email` <> ''))
